items.body_raw: Thus saith (perf.) Yahweh the God of Israel: Behold I give (ptc.) this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape from his hand, but thou shalt be captured and given into his hand.
items.answer_raw: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי נֹתֵן אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל וְשָׂרְפָהּ בָּאֵשׁ וְאַתָּה לֹא תִמָּלֵט מִיָּדוֹ כִּי תִלָּכֵד וְנִתַּתָּ בְיָדוֹ
Give (sing. masc.)
Take (pl. m.)
Be thou (m.) smitten (Niph.); or Niph. inf. cstr.
I will cause to fall (Hiph. of נפל)
Thou (m.) hast delivered (Hiph. of נצל)
Delivering (Hiph. ptc.)
And they were delivered (Niph.)
Give (2 m. s. emphatic imper., § 23. 2)
Thou (m.) wilt deliver them, or she will deliver them
Ye shall touch (impf. Qal of נגע)
Smitten (Niph. ptc. of נגף)
It was told or announced (Hoph. of נגד)
Tell or declare ye (Hiph.)
Look (2 s. m. jussive Hiph. of נבט; § 27. 1 (a) i); or 3 s. f. jussive Hiph., 'let her look'
To approach

items.body_raw: הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים אֱלֹהֵי תְּשׁוּעָתִי וּלְשׁוֹנִי תַּגִּיד צִדְקָתֶךָ
items.answer_raw: Deliver me from blood-guiltiness, O God of my salvation, and my tongue shall declare thy righteousness.

items.body_raw: כִּי תִדּוֹר נֶדֶר לַיהוָה אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח לְשַׁלְּמוֹ
items.answer_raw: When thou vowest a vow to Yahweh, do not forget to pay it.
His enemies were afraid to approach him.
Look now toward heaven, and count the stars.

items.body_raw: וַיַּפֵּל יהוה תַּרְדֵּמָה עַל־הָאָדָם וַיִּקַּח אַחַת מִצַּלְעֹתָיו וְהַצֵּלָע אֲשֶׁר לָקַח בָּנָה לְאִשָּׁה
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he took one of his ribs; and the rib which he had taken he built into a woman.

items.body_raw: אָמַר הָאָדָם הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה עִמָּדִי הִוא נָתְנָה־לִּי מִן־הָעֵץ
items.answer_raw: The man said, The woman whom thou gavest (to be) with me, she gave me of the tree.

items.body_raw: אָמַר יהוה אֶל־אַבְרָם הִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּאָרֶץ לְאָרְכָּהּ וּלְרָחְבָּהּ כִּי לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָם עַל פָּנָיו
items.answer_raw: Yahweh said to Abram, Walk through the land in the length of it and the breadth of it, for to thee will I give it; and Abram fell upon his face.

items.body_raw: חָלַם יַעֲקֹב וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה
items.answer_raw: Jacob dreamed, and, behold, a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven.
We have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the lands.

items.body_raw: של נעליך מעל רגליך כי המקום אשר אתה עומד עליו אדמת־קדש הוא
items.answer_raw: Put off thy sandals from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou art standing is holy ground.
תְּנוּ

items.body_raw: I will not give my silver and my gold.
items.answer_raw: לֹא אֶתֵּן אֶת־כַּסְפִּי וְאֶת־זְהָבִי
אַל־תַּגִּידוּ בְגַת

items.body_raw: Look not (f.) after thee, lest God smite thee.
items.answer_raw: אַל־תַּבִּיטִי אַחֲרַיִךְ פֶּן־יִגָּפֵךְ אֱלֹהִים

items.body_raw: Deliver me, for thou art my salvation.
items.answer_raw: הַצִּילֵנִי כִּי יְשׁוּעָתִי אָתָּה

items.body_raw: Let them give glory to Yahweh because of his loving-kindness.
items.answer_raw: יִתְּנוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדּוֹ

items.body_raw: When I gave the woman to the man for wife
items.answer_raw: בְּתִתִּי אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה לָאִישׁ לְאִשָּׁה

items.body_raw: I will deliver thee, and thy tongue shall tell-of my righteousness.
items.answer_raw: אַצִּילְךָ וּלְשׁוֹנְךָ תַּגִּיד צִדְקָתִי

items.body_raw: They feared to draw near, lest they should be smitten before their enemies.
items.answer_raw: יָרְאוּ מִגֶּשֶׁת פֶּן־יִנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיהֶם

items.body_raw: Thou hast caused a deep-sleep to fall upon me.
items.answer_raw: הִפַּלְתָּ עָלַי תַּרְדֵּמָה

items.body_raw: And he brought near the man and he took him in his arms and kissed him (dat.).
items.answer_raw: וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאִישׁ וַיְחַבֶּק־לוֹ וַיְנַשֶּׁק־לוֹ

items.body_raw: And the man rose-early in the morning and he told all these words in the ears of his servants.
items.answer_raw: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם הָאִישׁ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּגֵּד אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּאָזְנֵי עֲבָדָיו
Ye have delivered our lives from death.
And I gave them to the priest and his sons for an everlasting statute.

items.body_raw: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou and all the peoples that are with thee.
items.answer_raw: עַל־הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּפֹּל אַתָּה וְכָל־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ

items.body_raw: קַח נַפְשִׁי כִּי לֹא־טוֹב אָנֹכִי מֵאֲבֹתָי
items.answer_raw: Take away my life, for I am not better than my fathers.
Surely I will not take of anything that is thine.
